title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom (anifest 2026)

title_lang.en: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom (anifest 2026)
title_lang.zh_hk: 超級無敵羊咩咩大電影之怪獸農場 (anifest動画藝術祭2026)

synopsis:
Aardman Animations’ beloved animated series is back for another delightful adventure! The residents of Mossy Bottom Farm have been looking forward to Halloween – until the clumsy Farmer trashes the Flock’s beloved pumpkin patch! When Shaun channels his inner mad scientist to fix the problem, things rapidly spiral out of control... With The Farmer missing and a wild beast roaming the woods of Mossingham, all the ingredients are in place for a monstrously fun family adventure.

 

19/09 (Sat) 3:15pm | MMCP
Screening with: Silly Rhapsody (6 mins)

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
《超級無敵羊咩咩》、《超級無敵掌門狗》、《咪走雞》系列泥膠定格動畫班底又一爆笑力作！農場萬眾期待萬聖節，羊咩咩阿爽同羊兄羊弟守住南瓜田等開party。點知「撞板多過食飯」嘅農夫竟將南瓜田變成「南瓜浴」！阿爽把心一橫變身「瘋狂科學家」發明古怪裝置，誓要拯救萬聖節，結果愈救愈大鑊...... 實驗室爆煲，農夫忽然失踪，小鎮樹林又出現一頭來歷不明嘅長毛怪獸，成個小鎮雞飛狗走，今次點收科？

 

19/09（六）3:15pm | MMCP
同場加映得獎短片：《寫意狂想》（6分鐘）
